name: live-jazz
blurb: Told only “jazz”, Jev chose F major, 120 bpm and AABA, then walked ii–V–I in seventh chords and wrote a rest into the bridge.

name: live-mood
blurb: “Wistful, late night”: minor at 100% confidence, 72 bpm, an all-minor i–iv–v, two long notes a bar.

name: live-bossa
blurb: Told “bossa nova”, Jev split 50/50 on the mode, took C minor, 88 bpm, and leaned the whole tune on dotted off-beat rhythms.

name: demo-pop-loop
blurb: The four-chord pop loop C G Am F at 120; Jev writes a chorus over it, one arpeggiated motif per chord.
